thread:
Mara: Quick sync — planning social sequence for the benchmark webinar. Need: 1) X short clip, 2) stat slide, 3) copy variants for X + LinkedIn. Timeline: posts go Mon/Tue/Wed leading up to webinar. Who can take assets? @Devon?

Devon: I can make the slide. Need the raw benchmark CSV or the one-pager with numbers. Where is that?

Mara: Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/benchmark/q1-2026 — clip is raw from product team. @Jordan can you trim? :calendar:

Jordan: Yep. Send raw screen recording and mark 0:12-0:40 & 1:05-1:20 as highlight windows. I can produce 30s (1080x1080) w/ 5s intro.

Sophia: I'll draft copy. For X: short hook + statistic + CTA. For LinkedIn: 2-3 paragraph narrative with benchmark callout and a longer CTA. I'll post drafts here by Thu EOD.

Mara: Routing: inbound webinar leads should be tagged `micro-webinar-benchmark` and routed to SDR queue `webinar-seed`. @Elena can you add that rule?

Elena: On it. Confirm UTM params so we can map source correctly?

Mara: Use: `utm_campaign=benchmark_series&utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic`

Elena: Got it — will create rule and set lead priority to medium for qualifiers. I'll also add a test route to staging so we can validate.

Marc-bot: Reminder: scheduling windows available in Console -> Scheduling. Next optimal slot: Wed 09:00 PT.

Devon: Quick voice question — do we want bold/witty for X or more technical?

Sophia: Mix — lead with a bold hook, then one tight technical stat, end with clear CTA (register/watch). I'll make two X variations: one edgy, one conservative.

Jordan: For clip: include Redwood 3s brand stinger, then highlight cuts. Will output as MP4 and GIF variant for LinkedIn carousel.

Mara: Great. Also prepare fallback copy if engagement low: swap CTA to "Watch on demand" and pin slide as carousel. Sophia add fallback variants.

Sophia: Will add fallback + alt CTAs. Proposed schedule: Mon 11:00 PT — X short hook + clip; Tue 09:00 PT — LinkedIn long-form + stat slide; Wed 09:00 PT — X reminder + register CTA.

Devon: I'll finish slide numbers by Thu noon. Will include top-line stat + source line and a tiny methodology note.

Jordan: I'll upload final clip by Fri 12:00 PT to shared drive and ping here.

Elena: Routing rule created in staging. Will run a test at 16:00 PT today and confirm delivery to `webinar-seed-staging`.

Mara: Awesome. Can everyone review copy + slide by Thu EOD so we can schedule on Friday?

Devon: Reviewing slide — will flag any number discrepancies.

Sophia: Drop copy drafts in this thread by Thu 10:00 PT.

Jordan: Uploading raw recording link now: https://drive.redwood.ai/raw/recordings/rec_2026_03_23.mov

Mara: Thanks team :rocket: — once assets are uploaded, I'll schedule via Console and tag the posts with the UTM.

Elena: Test lead successfully routed at 16:04 PT — staging queue received a sample with tag `micro-webinar-benchmark`.

Mara: Perfect. Followups: 1) Devon finalize slide; 2) Jordan finalize clip; 3) Sophia post copy drafts; 4) Elena validate routing in prod after we confirm. Back in here when ready.

Devon: Noted.

Sophia: Copy drafts posted. small tweak needed on stat phrasing — will update momentarily.

Jordan: Clip uploaded: https://drive.redwood.ai/edits/clip_1080.mp4 — ping if trim changes needed.

Mara: Great work. If engagement drops below benchmark in first 48h we'll flip CTA and boost the slide.

Marc-bot: Scheduling job queued for Mon 11:00 PT.

Mara: Closing thread — thanks everyone!
